title: epi2me-labs/fastcat
description: Generate an offline fastcat HTML quality-control report from local FASTQ or BAM input.
workflow_description: Quality-control summary and HTML report for local FASTQ or BAM data.

input.title: Input Options
input.description: Select one local FASTQ or BAM file, or a directory containing input files of one format.

input.title: Input reads
input.description: Local FASTQ or BAM file, or a directory containing local input files. The format of one file is detected automatically.
input.help_text: fastcat writes the report to the Desktop-managed results directory.

input-fmt.title: Input format for folders
input-fmt.description: Required for a directory input. For one FASTQ or BAM file, fastcat detects the format automatically.

output.title: Report folder
output.description: Directory in which fastcat writes the report and summary files.

demultiplex.title: Demultiplex barcodes
demultiplex.description: Create separate summaries and reports for barcoded samples.

integrity.title: Input Integrity
integrity.description: Stop if fastcat encounters unreadable input or invalid read records.

force-error.title: Check input integrity
force-error.description: Fail the analysis if any input file or read record has an error.

read_output.title: Saved reads
read_output.description: Optionally save reads that pass FASTQ or unaligned-BAM filtering.

reads-output.title: Save reads
reads-output.description: Filename prefix for one saved-read file beneath the report folder, for example saved_reads. Fastcat adds .fastq.gz, or .bam when BAM output is selected. Do not enter a directory. This is unavailable for aligned BAM input and ignored when barcode demultiplexing is enabled.

bam-out.title: Save as BAM
bam-out.description: Save the reads as BAM rather than gzip-compressed FASTQ. This applies only when saving reads is enabled.

html-report.title: HTML report
html-report.description: Write the offline interactive HTML report.

threads.title: Threads
threads.description: Number of threads used for BAM decompression and report processing.
